notes: My tools panel scrolls: when you add many tools, swipe up and down (sideways when it lies flat) to reach them all. The ⠿ handle and the ⇅ ✎ buttons stay in place.
Tool names under every icon: in the side tool bar (Left or Right), in tab panels on phones and in the My tools panel.
Tab panels work on phones and tablets too: press and hold a tab, then drag it to the left, right or top. Press and hold without moving to pick a place from a list.
My tools panel buttons now each have their own box.
Tab panels now also work when WallCAD runs in a smaller window (like inside Claude). Right-click a tab to place its tools at the Left, Top, Right or Floating without dragging.
Every tool button inside a tab (Line, Circle, Move, Trim…) now has its own box, so the tools look clearly separate.
